actors.name: French Presidency of COP21
actors.private_context: The French Presidency is responsible for managing the COP21 climate conference and aims to produce a consolidated draft agreement text for negotiation. They have been working on draft texts and are aware of the need to circulate a text to national delegations before the final scheduled day of the summit.

actors.name: National Delegations
actors.private_context: Each national delegation is participating in COP21 and expects to receive draft agreement texts for review and negotiation. They have no prior knowledge of the specific content of the consolidated draft that the French Presidency may circulate.

shared_context: The COP21 climate conference is taking place in Paris from November 30 to December 11, 2015. The final scheduled day of the summit is December 11, 2015. The French Presidency has the authority to circulate draft agreement texts to national delegations. The conference aims to reach a global climate agreement.

starting_events.description: The COP21 climate conference officially opens in Paris.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the French Presidency of COP21 actually circulated at least one consolidated draft agreement text to national delegations before 2015-12-11T00:00:00+01:00 (the start of the final scheduled day). Otherwise resolve NO at the hard cutoff of 2015-12-10T09:00:00+01:00.
